summary: VitaGuide App Testing - Iteration 3: Comprehensive testing of recipe catalog (30 bilingual recipes), products catalog (DE/IT), click tracking, full E2E symptom analysis flow, and language switching. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend E2E flows verified.

minor.issue: LLM budget exceeded error in logs - system-level issue, not code bug

issues: Hardcoded 'Zusammenfassung' header - FIXED to use language-aware text (Riepilogo/Zusammenfassung)

critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding 'summary' translation key to i18n.ts instead of inline ternary for better maintainability
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major features tested: Recipe catalog (30 DE/IT recipes with images), Products catalog (30 DE, 61 IT with images/videos), Click tracking API, Diary CRUD+trends, Full symptom analysis E2E flow with 4 tabs (overview, supplements, nutrition, recipes), Language switching DE/IT verified on disclaimer, home, and results pages. Backend tests in test_recipes_products_api.py and test_diary_api.py. Fixed minor i18n issue with hardcoded 'Zusammenfassung' text.

backend_apis_tested: GET /api/recipes?lang=de - 30 recipes with title, image_url, ingredients, steps, tags
GET /api/products?lang=de - 30 German products with image_url, price
GET /api/products?lang=it - 61 Italian products with image_url, video_url
POST /api/track/click - stores click events with product_id, affiliate_url, source, timestamp
GET /api/diary - returns entries sorted by date descending
frontend_flows_tested: Home screen loads with DE language default, VitaGuide branding, symptom input, chips, analyze button, diary button
Language switch DE/IT changes all labels on home screen
Italian disclaimer screen with correct translations
Full symptom analysis E2E: enter symptoms -> select chips -> click analyze -> wait for LLM -> results page
Results page has 4 tabs: Übersicht/Panoramica, Supplements/Integratori, Ernährung/Nutrizione, Rezepte/Ricette
Rezepte tab shows recipe catalog with images from /api/recipes
Product cards with affiliate shop buttons (Zum Shop, Im Shop ansehen, Vedi nello shop)
Click tracking triggers POST to /api/track/click when shop buttons clicked
Results page works in Italian with correct tab labels
